title: The Long Curriculum
summary: Things worth knowing, learned properly: a self-paced path from an algebra refresh through first-year-graduate physics (deep core in mathematics, mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum and statistical physics; surveys in particle physics, astrophysics, general relativity and quantum field theory), chemical physics (quantum chemistry, spectroscopy and NMR), electives in signal processing and plasma physics for ICP-MS, and an AI track from probability and statistics through machine learning, neural networks and deep learning to transformers and large language models.
